name: zarchive_list_push_front_payload
description: zArchiveList::PushFrontPayload obtains a list node, stores the payload, links it at the circular-list head, and increments the list count.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage uses archive-list push/pop/remove behavior and the zSound stream request free/active-list transfer path.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x48c9c0 validates the free-node acquisition, payload store, circular head insertion, and count increment contract.
The native smokes verify push-front ordering, count/head maintenance, node reuse through the ZRDR free pool, and active/free zSound request queue insertion.
